properties.headline: Red Flag Warning issued November 17 at 12:46PM MST until November 18 at 5:00PM MST by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
The National Weather Service in Denver CO has issued a Red Flag
Warning.

* AFFECTED AREA...Fire Weather Zones 216 and 241.

* TIMING...From 8 AM to 5 PM MST Wednesday.

* WINDS...West 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 50 mph.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...Between 10 to 15 percent.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be favorable for rapid fire spread. Avoid
outdoor burning and any activity that may produce a spark and start
a wildfire.
properties.instruction:
Be sure you are signed up for your local emergency alert system. You
can find this information at dhsem.colorado.gov/emergencyalert.

* WINDS...West 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...Between 10 to 15 percent.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be favorable for rapid fire spread. Avoid
outdoor burning and any activity that may produce a spark and start

properties.instruction:
Be sure you are signed up for your local emergency alert system. You
can find this information at dhsem.colorado.gov/emergencyalert.

Follow all fire restrictions. Avoid activities that can cause sparks
and do not park hot vehicles on dry vegetation. One less spark, one
less wildfire.

A Red Flag Warning means that critical fire weather conditions are
either occurring now...or will shortly. A combination of strong
winds...low relative humidity...and warm temperatures can contribute
to extreme fire behavior.

properties.headline: Red Flag Warning issued November 18 at 4:07PM MST until November 18 at 4:00PM MST by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
Locally critical fire weather conditions may continue for the next
hour or so. However, across most of the Red Flag Warning area,
relative humidity has increased above critical levels and the strong
winds have decreased. Hence, the Red Flag Warning has been allowed to
expire.
